name: sloprail-content
description: Guardrails for a memories/topics/<topic>/units/ content workflow: a unit's frontmatter taxonomy (channels, type, tags) selects which writing rules apply, script rules catch what LLMs are bad at (character limits, banned phrases), a judge weighs the rest, and a unit cannot reach status: published without a cited user approval and a published_url. Generalizes and replaces a topic-local unit-satisfies-constraints guard.
